one_line: A Meitei king who codified Sagol Kangjei and a 19th‑century Manipuri polo captain whose play awed British officers.

appearance.age_look: King Khagemba appears in his late 30s with a lean, athletic build, while Keifa Singh appears in his early 30s with a similarly wiry rider’s build.
appearance.face: Both have oval faces with medium-brown Meitei complexions; Khagemba has a calm, sharp gaze with a firm jaw and a composed, strategic half-smile, while Keifa Singh’s expression is more openly intense and competitive, with slightly wider eyes and a ready, confident grin.
appearance.hair: Khagemba’s black hair is neatly tied into a high topknot bun at the back of the crown, wrapped in a deep-red Meitei headcloth band, while Keifa Singh’s black hair is pulled back into a low knot covered by a plain white cloth turban wrapped close to the head, leaving his forehead clear.
appearance.costume: Khagemba wears an early‑modern Meitei royal riding outfit: a long-sleeved, thigh-length white cotton tunic (phijom-style kurta) with a slightly flared hem and side slits, bound at the waist by a broad deep-red cotton sash; over this he has a sleeveless, fitted dark indigo cotton vest with simple woven borders, and he pairs it with narrow cream-coloured cotton trousers tucked into mid‑calf soft brown leather riding boots; his forearms are wrapped in red cotton bands, and he wears modest gold earrings and a thin gold neck torque, embodying courtly yet practical attire for Sagol Kangjei. Keifa Singh wears a mid‑19th century Manipuri polo rider’s costume: a plain, long-sleeved off‑white cotton tunic that falls to mid‑thigh, belted with a narrow dark green cloth sash, loose but tapered light‑brown cotton trousers tied at the ankles for riding, and simple dark brown leather sandals; he has a light, sleeveless olive-green cotton over-vest with minimal decoration, and a red cloth band tied around his right forearm as a team signal, with no heavy jewellery, emphasizing functionality and speed.
appearance.signature: Each carries a Sagol Kangjei polo stick: a slightly curved, dark-brown hardwood shaft about as tall as their shoulders with a compact mallet head, Khagemba’s wrapped at the grip with deep-red cloth and Keifa Singh’s with plain off‑white cloth, both worn smooth from use.

ref_desc: King Khagemba has a medium-brown oval face, black hair in a high topknot with a deep-red headband, a white tunic with indigo vest, cream trousers, red sash and brown riding boots, while Keifa Singh has a white turban, off‑white tunic, light‑brown trousers, olive vest, sandals, and both hold dark-brown Sagol Kangjei sticks with red or white-wrapped grips in a deep red, indigo, off‑white, cream and dark brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw an anime-style full-body model sheet of two Manipuri Sagol Kangjei figures from different centuries standing side by side on neutral ground, showing them clearly from head to toe: on the left, King Khagemba in early‑modern Meitei royal riding attire with a medium-brown oval face, calm sharp gaze and black hair tied into a high topknot wrapped in a deep-red headcloth band, wearing a long-sleeved, thigh-length white cotton tunic with slightly flared hem and side slits, a fitted sleeveless dark indigo cotton vest with simple woven borders, a broad deep-red cotton sash at the waist, narrow cream-coloured cotton trousers tucked into mid‑calf soft brown leather riding boots, red cloth wraps around his forearms, modest gold earrings and a thin gold neck torque, holding a dark-brown hardwood Sagol Kangjei stick as tall as his shoulder with a compact mallet head and a deep-red cloth-wrapped grip; on the right, Keifa Singh as a mid‑19th century Manipuri polo captain with a medium-brown oval face, intense competitive eyes and a confident grin, black hair pulled back into a low knot covered by a plain white cloth turban wrapped close to the head, wearing a plain long-sleeved off‑white cotton tunic to mid‑thigh belted with a narrow dark green cloth sash, loose yet tapered light‑brown cotton trousers tied at the ankles, simple dark brown leather sandals, a sleeveless olive-green cotton over-vest, and a red cloth band tied around his right forearm, holding his own dark-brown Sagol Kangjei stick with an off‑white cloth-wrapped grip; emphasize clean anime linework, consistent facial features and proportions, and the shared deep red, indigo blue, off‑white, cream and dark brown colour palette, with no text or labels anywhere in the image.
